title: Session archive
author: Zain Dana Harper
statement: Every artwork generated in the authoring session that is still recoverable, published whole rather than curated down. The Current Story sequence is drawn from this same body of work.
provenance: Assembled from four archives exported from the session. Each work records the sha256 and byte count of the PNG it came from, and the sha256 of the JPEG delivered here, so the chain from archive to page is inspectable. Delivered as JPEG because the source PNGs total 449MB.
exclusions: Reference and inspiration images supplied to the session are not present in any of these archives. One generated collage WAS present and is excluded here because it reproduces those reference images, which are other people's artwork.

excluded_items.name: a_large_composite_collage_moodboard_style_image.png
excluded_items.why: reproduces the supplied inspiration images (third-party artwork)
